notes: • Wikipick is much snappier: opening a saved article, searching and background saving no longer stall as your library grows. Undo now covers your own edits only — background saving clears it, so Undo no longer steps back through pages being downloaded.

• Applet settings now open in one Settings window from the ⋮ menu instead of crowding the menu itself. In Wikipick it holds Download over Wi-Fi only, Auto-save linked pages, the app's language, your library size and a link to Saving offline. Changing the language there switches the window and the app right away.

• Bodytomy: one selection window — search muscles, add them with +, reorder them, focus the camera on all of them at once, and isolate what

• NEW: Slices — cut the body along anatomical planes to see what lies beneath.

• Updates download in the background; installing is always your tap. (Correction: an earlier note said updates would start installing
• Tap Update once — Isa finishes in the background, and installs itself from the next update on.

• Bodytomy: rotation is now pixel-exact at every angle — fast and flawless. Turning used to leave the lighting behind: the body moved but the light and shade stayed where they were, so the figure seemed to change colour as it turned. Every step now re-lights the body exactly
